summary: The page exhibits RTL rendering defects including overlapping table headers, reversed timestamp strings, and disconnected status indicators across viewports.

issues.title: Table header text collision
issues.description: Column headers 'Line' and 'State' overlap due to improper column spacing in RTL mode.
issues.evidence: 'LineState' appears visually merged above the rightmost table column.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper column width constraints and spacing between header labels.

issues.title: RTL timestamp string reversal
issues.description: Relative time strings render in reversed word order under RTL formatting.
issues.evidence: The 'Updated' column displays 'h ago 2' instead of '2 h ago'.
issues.suggestion: Wrap relative time tokens in directional isolation containers.

issues.title: Misaligned sync status indicators
issues.description: Status indicators in the footer section are horizontally detached from their associated rows.
issues.evidence: A lone green dot and 'connecting' text float on the far left separate from the right-aligned source list.
issues.suggestion: Nest status badges directly inside the sync source row container.
